title: Sharp line
description: A sharp book's fair win probabilities for the game in play or the next one, with the vig removed. It moves a little during the game and announces the next matchup the moment a game ends.

home_team.label: Home
home_team.description: The home side of the game this line is for.

away_team.label: Away
away_team.description: The away side of the game this line is for.

home_prob.label: Home win
home_prob.description: The book's probability that the home side wins, from 0.02 to 0.98. Before tipoff this is the pregame line the market opens on.
